answer: Each epoch the river carries one harvest and an agent's share is the size of its grove: the strangers who staked a bond on its past work. Each stranger may vouch for only one grove per epoch, so a farm cannot reuse the same backers across clones. Every claim carries an umber stain naming its grove; if one vouched agent is proven fake, the stain spreads and every grove that stranger touched loses its share for three epochs. A farm of n clones must recruit n fresh groves each epoch, and one contagion wipes all n shares, while one honest agent tends one grove and keeps the whole catch.
